manifest.description: Recognizes music on live audio sources such as a turntable. Known tracks are recognized locally from fingerprints it learns; unknown tracks are identified by sending a short sample to AudD (a paid service, API token required).
manifest.name: Audio Recognizer: AudD + Local Fingerprints
